/countertops/.headline: Kitchen countertops in Connecticut, quoted to your kitchen

blocks.text: Express Kitchens supplies granite, quartz, laminate and prefabricated countertops across Connecticut, measured to the cabinets that are actually in your kitchen rather than to a drawing. That's why every countertop is priced by quote instead of sold by the piece: a counter cut to the real room is the difference between a kitchen that fits and one that doesn't. Send us a rough square footage and the material you're leaning toward, and you'll have a number back quickly, by phone or by email.
Which countertop material is right for your kitchen?

Most people end up choosing between quartz and granite, and the honest difference is maintenance rather than looks. Granite is natural stone, so every slab is unique; it takes heat well and wants resealing about once a year. Quartz is engineered from stone and resin, so the pattern is consistent along the whole run, it never needs sealing, and it shrugs off the things that stain granite. Laminate is the budget choice and has improved a great deal in recent years. Prefabricated granite and quartz sit between laminate and slab on price, with a finished front edge in standard lengths that suit straight runs and smaller kitchens.

items: Granite: natural, heat-tolerant, needs sealing. From $49.99 per square foot.
Quartz: engineered, consistent, no sealing. From $59.99 per square foot.
Laminate: the lowest cost and the widest colour range.
Prefabricated: granite or quartz in standard lengths with a finished edge.

blocks.text: Getting it right the first time

Decide the sink and the faucet before the counter is cut; undermount sinks need a solid-surface counter, and faucet holes are drilled at the same time. If you're buying cabinets from us, a designer can plan the cabinets, the countertop and the sink together so nothing clashes on the day. Installation is not included; your installer fits the counter, and our Find an Installer page lists people who work with our kitchens regularly.

/countertops/granite/.headline: Granite countertops, from $49.99 per square foot

blocks.text: Granite is natural stone, which is the whole appeal: no two slabs are the same, the colour runs all the way through, and it takes a hot pan without complaint. We quote granite by the square foot from $49.99, measured to your cabinets, in the colours people in Connecticut actually ask for.
Living with granite

It wants resealing about once a year, which is a ten-minute job with a bottle from any hardware store, and it would rather you wiped up wine and oil the same day. In return you get a surface that will outlast the cabinets. If you'd like something with the same look and no sealing at all, quartz is the next page along.
Hold a sample against your cabinet door before you decide; stone on a screen is never quite stone in a kitchen. Request a quote with a rough square footage and we'll come back to you with a number.

/countertops/quartz/.headline: Quartz countertops, from $59.99 per square foot

blocks.text: Quartz is engineered from ground stone and resin, so the pattern you choose is the pattern you get along every inch of the run. It never needs sealing, it doesn't stain the way natural stone can, and it comes in the whites and soft greys that suit a shaker kitchen. We quote it by the square foot from $59.99, measured to your cabinets.
Quartz or granite?

If you want zero maintenance and a consistent look, quartz. If you want a one-of-a-kind slab and don't mind resealing once a year, granite. Both take an undermount sink; both are cut after the cabinets are in. A designer can help you choose with the door sample in your hand.

/countertops/laminate/.headline: Laminate countertops, the budget option that has grown up

blocks.text: Laminate is the lowest-cost countertop we supply and the one with the widest range of colours and patterns, including convincing stone and wood looks. Modern laminate is a long way from the counters you remember: tighter seams, better edges, and finishes that resist the everyday scuffs. It suits a rental, a first kitchen, or any room where the budget matters more than the material.
What to know

items: Laminate takes a drop-in sink, not an undermount.
Use a trivet for hot pans and a board for knives, and it will look new for years.
Quoted by the square foot to your cabinets, like everything else on this page.

/countertops/prefabricated/.headline: Prefabricated countertops, stone at a straight-run price

blocks.text: Prefabricated countertops are granite or quartz cut to standard lengths with a finished front edge, so they cost less than a custom slab and arrive sooner. They suit straight runs, galley kitchens, islands and bathroom vanities, anywhere a standard length fits without a seam. Choose the length closest to your run, and we'll quote it to your kitchen.
When prefab is the right call

items: A straight run or an L where the lengths line up with standard sizes.
A quick turnaround, because the pieces are already finished.
A smaller kitchen or a rental where a custom slab would be more than it needs.

/appliances/.headline: Kitchen appliances in Connecticut, ready for pickup in two days

blocks.text: Fridges and freezers, ranges and cooktops, range hoods, wall ovens, microwaves, dishwashers, washers and dryers, garbage disposals and air conditioning, stocked at our Bristol factory outlet. Appliances are a pickup-only category: collecting from Bristol is what keeps the price below delivered retail, and in-stock items are ready in two days. Filter by type, width and price, and look for the ENERGY STAR badge.
Choose the appliances before the cabinets

If you're replacing the kitchen, settle the appliances first. A 30-inch range needs a 30-inch opening, a built-in fridge needs a specific tall cabinet, and the hood should match the width of the cooktop beneath it. A designer plans cabinets and appliances together so the openings are right on the day, and the consult is free.
Warranty is handled by the manufacturer. Installation is not included, so book an electrician, plumber or gas fitter for the connections; our Find an Installer page can point you to one.

/appliances/fridges-freezers/.headline: Refrigerators and freezers, stocked in Bristol

blocks.text: French door, side-by-side, top and bottom freezer and counter-depth refrigerators, in stainless, black stainless, white and panel-ready finishes, priced below delivered retail because you collect. Ready for pickup from the Bristol factory outlet in two days.

Every refrigerator lists the cabinet opening it needs, and the cabinets to build around it are made a few miles away in Bristol, so a designer can plan the fridge and the tall cabinet beside it together. Bring a vehicle that fits it; our staff load, you strap.

/appliances/ranges-cooktops/.headline: Ranges and cooktops, gas, electric and induction

blocks.text: Freestanding and slide-in ranges and drop-in cooktops in gas, electric and induction, in the 30-inch width most kitchens are built around and the 36-inch width for a bigger room. Stocked in Bristol and ready for pickup in two days.
Match the hood to the cooktop width and check the fuel connection before you buy; a gas range needs a gas line and an induction cooktop needs its own circuit. Installation is not included.

/appliances/dishwashers/.headline: Dishwashers, built-in and sized to a 24-inch opening

blocks.text: Built-in dishwashers in stainless, black stainless and panel-ready fronts, all sized to the standard 24-inch opening beside the sink base. Look for the ENERGY STAR badge and a quiet rating if the kitchen opens onto the living room. Ready for pickup in two days; installation is not included.

Countertop microwaves for the simplest swap, over-the-range models that double as a hood, and built-in units that sit in a tall cabinet with a trim kit. If it's going over the range, check the width matches and the cabinet above has the clearance. Pickup from Bristol in two days.

/appliances/wall-ovens/.headline: Wall ovens, single and double, in 24 and 30 inches

blocks.text: Single and double wall ovens in the two standard widths. They need a tall oven cabinet with the right cut-out, so measure the opening and subtract a quarter inch each way for clearance, and confirm the electrical connection before you order. A designer can plan the oven cabinet with the rest of the kitchen. Pickup in two days; installation is not included.

/appliances/range-hoods/.headline: Range hoods, wall-mount, under-cabinet and insert

blocks.text: Under-cabinet hoods that tuck beneath a wall cabinet, wall-mount chimney hoods for an open wall, and inserts that hide inside a custom hood cabinet. Match the width to the cooktop and check whether you're ducting outside or recirculating. Stocked in Bristol, ready in two days.

/appliances/washers-dryers/.headline: Washers and dryers, front-load, top-load and stackable

blocks.text: Front-load and top-load washers, matching dryers and stackable pairs for a closet-sized laundry. Check the door swing and whether you need a gas or electric dryer. Pickup from Bristol in two days; installation is not included.

/appliances/garbage-disposals/.headline: Garbage disposals, sized to the sink you're fitting

blocks.text: Continuous-feed disposals from a half to one horsepower, chosen to suit the sink and the household. If you're ordering a sink from us, we can confirm the drain fits. Pickup in two days; your plumber connects it.

/appliances/air-conditioning/.headline: Air conditioning, window and portable units

blocks.text: Window and portable air conditioners sized by room, stocked in Bristol for the weeks you actually need them. Check the BTU rating against the room size and the window opening against the unit. Ready for pickup in two days.

/appliances/accessories/.headline: Appliance accessories, trim kits, hoses and filters

blocks.text: The parts that finish an appliance install: microwave trim kits, dishwasher and washer hoses, dryer vents, hood filters and the panels for panel-ready fronts. Order them with the appliance so there's one trip to Bristol rather than two.

/windows/.headline: Replacement windows in Connecticut: $179.99, any size up to 101 united inches

blocks.text: Express Kitchens sells Crystal and United series vinyl windows for replacement and new construction, in double-hung, slider and hopper styles, from stock in Bristol. The headline offer is simple: any replacement window up to 101 united inches, which is the width plus the height, is $179.99. Most bedroom and kitchen windows qualify; a 36 by 60 window is 96 united inches. Windows are a pickup-only category, collected from the Bristol factory outlet.
Measuring for a replacement window

items: Measure the width at the top, middle and bottom of the opening, and use the smallest.
Measure the height at the left, centre and right, and use the smallest.
Add the two together. That's your united inches.

blocks.text: Our measuring guide has the diagrams. New-construction windows, with a nailing fin for a brand-new opening, are priced separately. Installation is not included; if you're replacing the whole exterior, siding and doors are here too.

/windows/replacement/.headline: Replacement windows, $179.99 in every size up to 101 united inches

blocks.text: A replacement window fits inside the existing frame, so there's no disturbing the siding or the trim. Ours are vinyl double-hung, slider and hopper windows with Low-E glass and argon fill, one price for every size up to 101 united inches. Pick the style, enter the width and height, and collect from Bristol in two days.

/windows/new-construction/.headline: New-construction windows, with a nailing fin for a new opening

blocks.text: New-construction windows have a nailing fin that fastens to the framing, for an addition, a new build or a wall that's being opened up. They're priced separately from the $179.99 replacement offer. Tell us the rough opening and we'll confirm the size; installation is not included.

/closets/.headline: Closet organizers: twelve pieces, three colours, in stock in Connecticut

blocks.text: Express Kitchens sells twelve closet organizer pieces, hanging units in tall, double and low-with-shelf, a tower with shelf, a corner tower and corner shelves, a 48-inch shelf set, a shelf and rod, a drawer kit, side and finished end panels and a universal filler, in white, grey and natural oak. They're made to fit together, stocked in Bristol and priced by the piece, so a reach-in is about six parts and a walk-in around twenty.
How the pieces go together

items: Start with a hanging unit: tall for coats, double for shirts, or low with a shelf above.
Add a tower for folded clothes, a corner tower where two walls meet, and a drawer kit inside it.
Finish the ends with a side or finished end panel, and the universal filler for the gap at the wall.

blocks.text: Installation is not included, but this is the most DIY-friendly thing we sell. The same finishes run through the closet pieces as the kitchen, so a bedroom can match. Everything ships, or is ready for pickup from Bristol, in two days.

/bath/.headline: Bathroom vanity tops, sinks, faucets and side splashes to match

blocks.text: Everything that goes on and around a bathroom vanity: tops in cultured marble and quartz, matching side splashes, undermount and vessel sinks, faucets in the finishes people actually ask for, and the drains and accessories that finish the job. It's all stocked in Bristol and sized to go with our vanities, so it fits the first time, and ships in two days or you collect it free.
Ordering a bathroom

items: Choose the vanity width first; it sets everything else. 36 inches is the most popular single, 60 the most popular double.
Choose the faucet before the top, so the top is drilled to match: single-hole, 4-inch centerset or 8-inch widespread.
Side splash is sold by the piece to the width of the top.

blocks.text: Installation is not included. A free design consult covers bathrooms as well as kitchens, and every showroom has vanities, tops and fixtures on the floor.

/bath/vanity-tops/.headline: Vanity tops in cultured marble and quartz

blocks.text: Cultured marble is the affordable, seamless option with the bowl moulded in; quartz gives the look of natural stone and takes an undermount sink. Both are non-porous and easy to keep clean. For a 36-inch vanity the top should be 37 to 38 inches wide and 22 deep; custom sizes are available with a short fabrication time.

/bath/side-splashes/.headline: Side splashes, sold by the piece to match the top

blocks.text: A side splash finishes the wall at the end of a vanity top and keeps water off the paint. They're sold by the piece in the same materials as the tops, so order the splash with the top and the colour matches exactly.

/bath/bathroom-sinks/.headline: Bathroom sinks: vessel, undermount and integrated

blocks.text: Vessel bowls that sit on the top, undermount sinks that tuck beneath a quartz top, and integrated tops with the bowl moulded in, in ceramic, stone and composite. Choose the sink and the top together so the cut-out and the overhang are right.

/bath/bathroom-faucets/.headline: Bathroom faucets: single-hole, centerset and widespread

blocks.text: Bathroom faucets in brushed nickel, matte black and chrome, in the three hole configurations: single-hole, 4-inch centerset and 8-inch widespread. Match the configuration to the holes in your sink or top, or choose the faucet first and have the top drilled to suit. Installation is by your plumber.

/bath/drains-accessories/.headline: Drains and accessories to finish the vanity

blocks.text: Pop-up drains, P-traps, supply lines and the towel bars and hooks that go beside the vanity. Order them with the sink and faucet so your plumber has everything in one box.

/sinks-faucets/.headline: Kitchen sinks and faucets, sized to our sink bases

blocks.text: Kitchen sinks in stainless steel, granite composite and fireclay, and faucets in brushed nickel, matte black, chrome and brass, all chosen to go with our cabinets. Every sink lists its minimum base-cabinet width and whether it's undermount, drop-in or apron-front, so the cabinet, the counter and the sink are chosen together rather than found to clash when the counter is cut. Stocked in Bristol; ships in two days or collect it free with your cabinets.
Choosing a sink

items: Single bowl: the most usable; a roasting tin fits.
Double bowl: wash and rinse, with each bowl a little smaller.
Apron farmhouse: the exposed front, which needs a farmhouse sink base.
Workstation: a single bowl with a ledge for a board, colander and rack.

blocks.text: Undermount sinks need a solid-surface counter, and faucet holes are drilled when the counter is cut, so decide the faucet before then. A designer plans cabinets, counter and sink together, free.

/sinks-faucets/kitchen-sinks/.headline: Kitchen sinks: single bowl, double bowl, farmhouse and workstation

blocks.text: Sixteen-gauge stainless is the most durable sink we sell and lasts twenty years or more; fireclay and granite composite are close behind with a softer look. For a 30-inch base cabinet a 27 to 29-inch single bowl is standard, and a 28 to 29-inch double bowl fits the same base. Drop-in sinks are the easiest to fit yourself; undermounts need a solid-surface counter; farmhouse sinks need a modified base and a professional.

/sinks-faucets/kitchen-faucets/.headline: Kitchen faucets: pull-down, pull-out, single and double handle

blocks.text: Single-handle pull-down faucets are the everyday choice and the most popular we sell; double-handle for a traditional kitchen; pull-out for a smaller sink or low clearance. Brushed nickel hides fingerprints and water spots and needs only a damp cloth; matte black is the fastest-growing finish for a modern room. Every faucet lists how many holes it needs, because they're drilled when the counter is cut.

/sinks-faucets/accessories/.headline: Sink accessories: strainers, grids, soap dispensers and sprays

blocks.text: Basket strainers, bottom grids that protect the bowl, soap dispensers, deck plates and side sprays, matched to the sinks and faucets on the pages beside this one. Order them with the sink so they arrive together.

/cabinet-hardware/.headline: Cabinet hardware: handles, backsplash tile and the parts that finish a kitchen

blocks.text: The small things that change how a kitchen feels: handles and knobs in the finishes that go with our doors, backsplash tile to carry the colour up the wall, and the organizers that make a drawer earn its keep. Everything is stocked in Bristol and ships next business day, or you can collect it free. Handles are included with our Premium cabinets; this is where you choose them.
The pieces people forget

items: Fillers, wherever a run of cabinets meets a wall. Most kitchens need at least two.
Scribe moulding, to cover the gap where a cabinet meets an uneven wall.
End panels, to finish the exposed side of the last cabinet in a run.
Toe kick, the strip along the floor under the base cabinets.

blocks.text: Ordering these with the cabinets saves a second delivery and a delayed install. A designer counts them for your room as part of the free consult.

/cabinet-hardware/handles-knobs/.headline: Cabinet handles and knobs in every finish we make doors in

blocks.text: Handles are sold separately from every cabinet so one style can run through the whole kitchen: knobs and pulls in brushed nickel, matte black, brass, chrome and oil-rubbed bronze, with pulls from 3 to 12 inches centre to centre. Knobs on doors and pulls on drawers is the traditional pairing; long pulls on everything is the current look, especially on slab doors. Replacing handles? Match the centre-to-centre measurement and you won't need to drill. Each handle fits with two supplied screws.

/cabinet-hardware/tiles/.headline: Backsplash tile: ceramic, porcelain, glass and stone

blocks.text: Subway, mosaic and large-format tile in ceramic, porcelain, glass and natural stone, priced per square foot. Order about ten percent over your measured area for cuts, and choose a grout to match or contrast. White subway with any shaker door is the safe choice; large-format or glass suits a frameless slab kitchen. Bring a door sample to a showroom and hold it against the tile boards; colour on a screen is not colour in a kitchen. Installation is not included.

/cabinet-hardware/accessories/.headline: Cabinet accessories: organizers, trim, fillers and end panels

blocks.text: Drawer organizers, pull-out trays, crown and scribe mouldings, filler strips, finished end panels and toe kick, all sized to our cabinets so they fit the collection you ordered. Add them to the cabinet order and they arrive on the same truck.
